rules.timing_rule: relative to the launch calendar in the approved brief: E1 at announcement, E2-E4 spaced across the pre-launch window, E5 on the day before doors open; every stated date or deadline comes from the brief, never invented
rules.objective_note: the frozen objective enum has no pre-launch value; this profile defaults to promotional and must never widen the enum from a lane file

variant_pairing.pairing: subject and preview are paired per variant (Pair A = subject A + preview A; Pair B = subject B + preview B); pairs are preserved through the Skill-44 draft handoff, never flattened into unpaired lists
variant_pairing.pair_b_style: prolific and disruptive, truthful and on brand (no false account alert, no fake reply prefix, no fabricated urgency, no misleading price, no fake scarcity)

rules.intake: the approved S49 shared-launch brief, consumed by the launch intake adapter with per-field provenance; the legacy one-block questionnaire applies only in explicit legacy interactive mode
rules.review_labels: the private client-review document labels each email with its framework and labels the body 'Email Body:'; the recipient payload carries no framework labels, slot instructions, or production commentary
rules.trigger: Signature Launch build: the five pre-launch emails are written before the doors-open date, from the approved launch brief and the approved landing page; the sequence runs before the main launch 10 and every CTA points at the opt-in / waitlist page
rules.registration_note: not yet in catalog-index.json / catalog-built-index.json and not yet in SEQ_LENGTHS / PREVIEW_EXPECTED / _sequence_type; until the integrator registers the profile, a run resolving sequence_type signature_launch_prelaunch fails AF-EMAIL-TYPE-MISMATCH by design
